stage: 3J2 immutable pipeline signatures and stage-3 closure
scope: Program module/layout signatures are serialized once per resolved immutable program. Draws use an explicit normalized static-state tuple and short per-program variant lookup. The authoritative global pipeline map is checked on every hit, so deletion, clearing and validation rejection remain visible. Dynamic blend/stencil/alpha values remain outside static keys.
warcraft3: Pinned legacy UNORM/upload/FFP diagnostic passes original unchanged frozen policy; documented candidate differences remain.
next: Stage 4 guest shared runtime: begin pure C library, common retry/upload mechanics, then process-unique owner and driver multi-owner support.
